profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Instacart
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working on micro-services, using AWS to design, develop, and support complex architectures for backend services acting as a platform for pricing, and separately for providing delivery estimates. Natural and practiced leadership abilities to influence the team for positive and productive growth.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain scalable, full CD microservices to create the infrastructure responsible for processing and managing B2B discounts Amazon has for its customers. AWS, integration tests, agile development, and software architecting are all used to develop these systems predominantly in java. Experience providing live support & fixing customer issues.

positions.title: Student Teaching Assistant
positions.description: 3 Courses: Engineering programming, Fundamentals of Programming, Object-Oriented Programming. Responsibilities include grading, tutoring, aiding, and teaching.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked with java, a dependency injection framework, and a new cutting edge, internally-developed framework to create a new view on a mobile app. Pioneering by being one of the first to use this new framework, I had dived into exploring the use of new technologies for the team and consumers.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
